A double tree decomposition partitions the edges of a double tree into two trees. Such a decomposition is $k$k-balanced if, at every vertex, the absolute difference between its degrees in the two trees is at most $k$k.\\n\\n2-balanced double tree decomposition conjecture. Any double tree has a $2$2-balanced double tree decomposition.\\n\\nThe paper proves that every double tree has a decomposition that is $4$4-balanced, improving the previously known bound of five.
